component_policy: verified SMD substitution allowed when exact catalog/CAD part is unavailable; original and actual MPN must be recorded
wire_landing_policy: external battery/pump/fan/sensor/RPM/ignition/service wiring is direct-soldered to dedicated PCB landings; no connector/socket/terminal/header footprints
programming_method: temporary external fixture contacting exposed PCB test pads; no onboard detachable programming connector
calibration_method: factory calibration via exposed test/calibration pads; versioned CRC-protected nonvolatile calibration records
